query: INSERT INTO noo_heartbeat_runs SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::noo_heartbeat_runs, s.payload)).* FROM noo_heartbeat_run_prune_staging s WHERE s.prune_run_id = $1 AND s.restored_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM noo_heartbeat_tasks t WHERE t.id = s.task_id) ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING
